authoredFrom: SOL-16 — NatSpec. Authored 2026-09-30 from the analyzer's measured output. Before SOL-16 this lane read NO documentation: 5,254 `comment` nodes over the 389-file corpus, zero reaching a symbol, so `brain_symbol.docstring` was NULL for every Solidity symbol the index has ever produced. Solidity's `///` and slash-star forms are exactly what the TypeScript lane extracts from JSDoc, so this was the largest single depth gap between the two analyzers.
note: Three comment FORMS, pinned separately, because a lane that reads documentation must be able to say which form it read: a stray `//` remark above a declaration is not documentation of it. `natspec-line` is `///`, `natspec-block` is the slash-star form, `line` is a plain remark. TWO bugs surfaced only because this fixture was written, and neither was visible on the corpus: (1) attachment read `nextNamedSibling` per COMMENT, but only the LAST comment of a run has the declaration as its next sibling — so `library Docs` came out documented as `@author Someone` with the `@title` and `@notice` above it silently dropped, i.e. 1 line kept out of every 3; (2) the run anchor was never reset after a flush, so a TRAILING run at the end of a parent reused the previous declaration and published the file's closing remark as part of `IThing`'s docstring. The gap between `commentsRead` and `commentsAttached` on the corpus is real and is not a defect: a comment before an expression, or a trailing remark, documents nothing.

forbidSymbols.name: natspec-sol16.sol
forbidSymbols.comment: The module symbol carries NO docstring. The SPDX comment is followed by `pragma solidity`, whose node type is `pragma_directive` — not a declaration — so the run has no declaration to land on. Publishing the licence as the file's docstring would be a different feature (licence detection), and it is named here as absent rather than quietly half-done.

forbidRelationships.comment: Structural guard that the trailing run published nothing: the file's closing remark must not become a symbol or an edge. This is the failure the anchor-reset fix addresses, and it is pinned as a relationship rule as well as through `IThing`'s exact docstring so a regression shows up in whichever direction it first appears.
